positions.commentary: Google is considered a credible bidder for IPL media rights due to its large user base in India.

thesis: This episode identifies Google (GOOGL) as a credible potential bidder for Indian Premier League (IPL) media rights, citing its substantial user base in India as the primary justification for this bullish view.

claims.claim: Google is considered a credible bidder for IPL media rights due to its large user base in India.
claims.quote: David: Google and Facebook are extremely credible bidders here. Ben: And in fact, Google did at one point have a deal. In 2010, YouTube did a media rights deal with the IPL.
